claims.content: The system enables a customer to recover forgotten account access by generating and sending a temporary password to their registered email address upon request.

goal.raw_text: The system enables a customer to recover forgotten account access by generating and sending a temporary password to their registered email address upon request.

claims.content: Customer
The customer must have a previously registered account with a valid email address on file.
The customer clicks the 'Forgot Password' or 'Forgot Member ID' link on the Sign in page.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Forgot Password' or 'Forgot Member ID' link on the Sign in page.

claims.content: The customer clicks the 'Forgot Password' or 'Forgot Member ID' link on the Sign in page.
The system displays a section (DIV) containing a field for the customer to enter their email address.
The customer enters their registered email address into the provided field.
The system generates an email containing a temporary password and sends it to the customer's registered email address.
The customer checks their email inbox to retrieve the temporary password.
The customer is advised to change the temporary password after receiving it.

If the customer's account is closed or suspended, the system displays a popup message stating: 'We're sorry, this account has been closed [suspended]. If you believe this is an error, please call or email Customer Care at (800) 123-4567 or Auctions@jtv.com.'
The system has generated and sent an email containing a temporary password to the customer's registered email address.
The customer is advised to change the temporary password.
